race.comment: COOL BLAZE (1) is the one to beat on the strength of her better 1000m profile and BM60 background, even though her last preparation ended with two below-par Canberra runs. She has one win and three placings from seven starts at this distance, gets a 1.5kg claim and resumes for the new barn. Can fire. MOVER AND SHAKER (7) was last of six at Kumbia but only beaten two and a half lengths after being slow away, and her previous Tara Mdn win by just over five lengths gives her a strong enough case back to 1000m. BAY OF THE SOUTH (4) broke through at Charleville, beating Daddys Maggie, and Paul Randall stays aboard, though she now has to carry that Mdn win into a harder meeting. BELLA ANGELICA (3) resumes after a poor finish to her last campaign in BM62 grade, but the prior standard of form and a past placing at around 1000m keep her in the mix for a minor share if she returns cleanly. SPANISH RAGE (8) is next best.
